decision_scope: service diagnostic only; no scientific evidence, hypothesis, plan, seed, candidate or scoring

literature_assumption_gate.SRC-0165: candidate-visible non-iid pairs must be shown to share at least one varying latent factor under one source-identical generative account
literature_assumption_gate.SRC-0166: one candidate-visible auxiliary variable must satisfy a stated conditional-independence and variability/rank mapping
literature_assumption_gate.SRC-0167: an intervention must target a mapped latent and meet the paper's support/intervention conditions rather than merely correlate with an outcome
literature_assumption_gate.SRC-0168: candidate-visible groups must be groups of observational variables satisfying the paper's mixing assumption, not sample/world IDs

prohibited_shortcuts: family labels, native types, paths, semantic channel names or hidden event/intervention flags
three-family slot-number ranges or native-width mask signatures
held-out WT seeds 8 and 9 or any three-family test target
post-diagnostic threshold, feature, pairing or auxiliary-variable changes

candidate_visible_fields: support input/next-target ordered pairs and masks
world boundary and within-tensor row order
three_family_static_audit.required_decision: retain only an auxiliary rule available with identical meaning in ncmapss_ds08a, dronepropa and continuous_event without mask or slot routing

wt_development_diagnostic.public_auxiliary: the normalized mechanically unique scalar control in WTEpisode.control
wt_development_diagnostic.response_signature: for each episode, mean(target rows 0:16) minus mean(history rows 16:32), retaining all ten anonymous coordinates
wt_development_diagnostic.classifier: Euclidean nearest train-control centroid; invariant to a consistent channel permutation
wt_development_diagnostic.randomization: 256 independent permutations of the 54 train auxiliary labels from numpy PCG64 seed 129031; features, development labels and centroids otherwise unchanged
wt_development_diagnostic.rank: matrix rank of the four centered train-control centroids using numpy's default SVD tolerance
wt_development_diagnostic.conditional_dependence: after subtracting each train-control centroid, absolute off-diagonal Pearson correlations across the ten signature coordinates

overall_pass_rule: all numerical WT gates pass and at least one cited theorem maps all required assumptions to a source-identical signal that supports the claimed cross-world scope; a within-one-system predictive association alone cannot pass

outcomes.pass: a later wake may create one low-confidence hypothesis before any implementation or scoring
outcomes.fail: append no_observable_auxiliary_identifiability_contract and create no hypothesis, candidate, plan, benchmark or schema
